synopsis: From astromech driods plotting courses across the galaxy to protocol droids translating many different languages - droids are central to life the galaxy and can do almost anything! Learn about different types of droids and their many functions and become a droid expert and master builder. This kit includes a 64-page paperback book and thick puzzle-like pieces to build your own BB-8, C-3PO, and R2-D2. Take your favorite droids along for the ride on your next mission in the galaxy.
title: Star Wars Builders: Droids
